messages:
Maria: heads-up, release-bot tagged analytics-service v2.3.0 from a docs-only PR. can we revert to a patch (v2.2.1)?
AJ: saw it. bot's current heuristic treats any change outside `test/` as minor. that's noisy.
release-bot: Release created by releasebot/auto-bump. PR #5120 (docs/examples). Diff summary: changes under docs/ and README.md. No src/ changes detected. Proposed tag: v2.3.0.
David: if customers pin ~2.2.x they'll skip v2.3, but some customers watch minors. We shouldn't signal new features.
Sophie: Agreed. Minor bump feels wrong for docs-only. Maria, can you confirm the paths?
Maria: Confirmed: only `docs/usage.md` and `README.md` touched. No changelog entry. Requesting removal of v2.3.0 and create v2.2.1 patch.
AJ: long-term: suggest bot rule order: 1) honor PR labels (e.g., `chore/docs` => patch), 2) path whitelist (docs/, website/, .md), 3) scan changelog for keywords (`feat:`, `deprecate`, `BREAKING`) to escalate.
David: also add a manual override annotation in the PR body like `release: patch` that the bot can read.
Sophie: I can delete the tag now and re-run the bump job. Anyone object?
Maria: no objections. please proceed and leave a note in the release body about the revert.
release-bot: Tag v2.3.0 deleted by @Sophie. New candidate: v2.2.1 (awaiting manual confirmation).
Sophie: cut v2.2.1. release body: "docs-only PR #5120, converted to patch bump per label/paths policy". Monitoring for clients pinned to 2.2.x.
AJ: I'll file a tiny RFC/PR to change the bot heuristic and include PR labels + path summary in the release note. Also adding `release: patch|minor|major` opt-out in PR body.
David: one more ask: include changed paths list and PR labels in the release note so reviewers don't need to dig.
Maria: agreed. action items: @AJ update bot, @Maria write RFC, @Sophie watch the patch rollout. Closing once we see no problems. :thumbsup:
Sophie: logs look clean so far, no client issues reported.
Maria: ack, thanks everyone.
